evades_obstructions.obstruction: Davenport-Heilbronn / Epstein (h>1) RH-false lookalikes satisfying FE + explicit formula + L2 means (S1)
evades_obstructions.how: The machinery's input is Lambda(n) >= 0 at every prime power (log-derivative coefficient positivity = full Euler product), consumed through the first rung (non-vanishing on the 1-line via 3-4-1 trigonometric positivity) and through the depth-direction complete-monotonicity constraints. DH and Epstein (class number > 1) violate Lambda >= 0, and both classically have zeros with beta > 1 (Davenport-Heilbronn 1936; flagged classical), so they FAIL THE FIRST RUNG of the ladder: their analogue of 'Re xi'/xi > 0 on sigma >= 1' is already false. No proportion-type method separates zeta from the lookalikes at its first proven instance; this one does.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: o(N)-blindness of all density/proportion/moment-ladder methods (S2)
evades_obstructions.how: The target is emptiness of the negativity body N = {sigma > 1/2 : Re xi'/xi <= 0}, equivalently kappa_a = 0 for all a > 1/2 — never a proportion. A single off-line zero rho0 = beta0 + i*gamma0 of any multiplicity forces u(s) -> -infinity as s -> rho0 from the left (term m0(sigma-beta0)/|s-rho0|^2), opening an open plume in N and charging kappa_a >= 1 for every a in (1/2, beta0). The ladder's top rung IS 'every single zero on the line'.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: Multiplicity-blindness of the Weil-form certificate: on-line double indistinguishable from off-line pair (lemmaR_tight) (S3)
evades_obstructions.how: In the tilt field an on-line zero of multiplicity m is a positivity SOURCE of strength m(sigma-1/2)/|s-rho|^2 (numerically verified: u(sigma, gamma_1) = 1/(sigma-1/2)), while kappa_a charges only zeros with beta > a, WITH multiplicity (Krein-Langer negative squares of K_a — precisely the tx_048 residue: 'multiplicity counted, unlike the Weil form'). The lemmaR_tight blind spot (double vs pair of depth d -> 0) is resolved layer by layer: TRP(a) for a in (1/2, 1/2+d) sees the pair and never charges the double.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: 'Every route's first substantive step is Weil positivity in disguise' + Bombieri's small-support triviality (S4)
evades_obstructions.how: TRP(a) for a > 1/2 is NOT a Weil-positivity cone statement: it is quasi-RH(a) (zero-free half-plane), strictly weaker than RH for every a > 1/2, with genuine unknown content at every a < 1 — unlike small-support Weil positivity (unconditional and empty) the ladder has real intermediate rungs. Weil positivity appears only as the degenerate boundary derivative at a = 1/2 (R4 identity: d/da log|xi(a+it)/xi(1-a+it)| at a=1/2 equals 2*pi*nu_X), which the program never touches. The added positivity generators are on the sanctioned analytic list: reflection positivity (OS-Schwarz with Pontryagin-index bookkeeping for the tilted reflection theta_a) and complete monotonicity (finite totally-monotone exponential prime sums from Lambda >= 0), the first verified for zeta at the a >= 1 rung (Lean), the second verified by construction.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: Alternative Hypothesis world (S5)
evades_obstructions.how: TRP consumes no spacing statistics whatsoever. An AH world with all zeros on the line satisfies TRP at every level; the machinery is orthogonal to AH and never needs to refute it — its data coordinate is depth (sigma-profiles), not gaps.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: Bombieri-Garrett ~94% spectral cap (S5)
evades_obstructions.how: No pseudo-Laplacian and no realization of zeros as discrete spectrum of a self-adjoint operator. The OS reconstruction yields the Poisson semigroup e^{-x|D_t|} on positive harmonic boundary data, with off-line zeros appearing as Pontryagin DEFECTS (negative squares of K_a), which no spectral-fraction cap constrains.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: Conrey-Li counterexamples to de Branges positivity (S5)
evades_obstructions.how: Conrey-Li kill de Branges' sufficient positivity conditions for the space AT criticality a = 1/2. The tilt family works strictly at a > 1/2, never invokes de Branges' axioms, and uses only the Krein-Langer index theorem (an unconditional theorem about generalized Schur functions, since Theta_a is unimodular on R by the FE). The degenerate critical kernel K_{1/2} is never used.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: Rodgers-Tao Lambda_dBN >= 0: no sub-critical margin (S5)
evades_obstructions.how: The tilt flow is in the sigma-direction, not de Bruijn-Newman heat-flow time; Rodgers-Tao does not constrain it. Margin is built in at every a > 1/2 (quasi-RH(a) is an open condition, numerically margin ~ 0.046(a-1/2) in the verified range) and criticality is approached only through the ladder — no sub-critical smoothing is ever invoked, respecting the 'barely true' lesson.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: Formalized bandwidth-one ceiling (0.6818287), two-moment tightness, dimension cap (S5)
evades_obstructions.how: Those cap certificates that read the t-frequency form factor with Fourier support <= 1 configuration-by-configuration. TRP certificates read a coordinate that model does not parametrize: sigma-profiles (depth data, constrained by complete monotonicity in a) and t-LOCAL pointwise positivity in width-O(1) windows. The 256-law configuration has all mass on the line, hence trivially satisfies every TRP(a) — it cannot calibrate or cap this method. The honest analogue calibrator (a 'tilted law' planting off-line zeros while matching all prime-computable tilted-EF data across a-levels) does not exist yet; building it is milestone 3 and would be the field's own stress test.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: Parity problem (S5)
evades_obstructions.how: Not a sieve: the mechanism consumes Lambda >= 0 jointly with analytic continuation and the functional equation through the harmonic function u = Re xi'/xi; parity constrains combinatorial sieve identities, not positivity theory of the completed zeta.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: Degree obstruction (two-thirds method empty for GL(2)) — bonus
evades_obstructions.how: The tilt ladder is degree-blind: E_a(z) = Lambda_F(a - iz) and kappa_a make sense for any completed L-function, and the first rung (positivity on sigma >= sigma_1(F)) survives with the same Euler-positivity proof; there is no Montgomery-Vaughan bandwidth step anywhere, hence no Lambda* = 1/degree wall.

failure_modes: Margin propagation (milestone 4) may be exactly as hard as widening classical zero-free regions: the archimedean drift in the a-flow costs ~ (1/2)log t per unit of descent, so descending from a=1 to a=1/2 needs pointwise prime-side forcing of size log t — Lindelof-adjacent. The field could mature into an elegant RP-reformulation of Vinogradov-Korobov without passing it. Mitigation: milestone 4 has an explicit falsifiable success criterion, and the reformulation itself yields spin-offs (localization, GL(m) uniformity).

The OS/RP layer could be decorative: the reconstructed semigroup is the Poisson semigroup, and OS-Schwarz might yield nothing beyond classical harmonic-function estimates (Hadamard + Borel-Caratheodory). Early test: milestone 2 must produce at least one inequality not derivable classically, else the layer is demoted and the field stands on anchoring + CM alone.

Depth-CM constraints may lack detection power: negativity plumes are thin (width ~ 1/((beta-a) log gamma)), and the depth signal of rare off-line zeros may drown in the on-line ambient (~log T zeros per unit window) — the same visibility/interference wall that emptied the negative-index compression route. Localization in t mitigates (one zero dominates near its own plume), but prime-computable windows of width 1 may not resolve plume-scale sigma-structure at height T without sums of length T^c. The milestone-3 LP experiment quantifies this early and cheaply.

Recalled literature could fail verification: (i) Lagarias, Acta Arith. 89 (1999) 'On a positivity property of the Riemann xi-function' — statement Re xi'/xi > 0 on Re s >= 1 unconditionally and RH iff positivity on Re s > 1/2; (ii) Lagarias (~2005-06) Hermite-Biehler property of xi(a - iz) for a >= 1; (iii) Trudgian's explicit |S(t)| <= 0.112 log t + 0.278 loglog t + 3.385; (iv) Krein-Langer factorization applicability (needs Theta_a of bounded type in C+; should follow from xi having order 1, must be checked); (v) Davenport-Heilbronn 1936 zeros in sigma > 1 for DH and Epstein h>1. All flagged; none is load-bearing for the field's DESIGN but (i),(iii) are load-bearing for the first theorem's constants.

The anchoring constants may degrade near small |t_0| or sigma_0 near the edge of the strip; handleable technically (verified-computation region covers small heights) but could make the transfer theorem's collars ugly.

The milestone-3 calibrator could reveal a genuine no-go: an RH-false zero-configuration matching ALL prime-computable tilted-EF data at every a-level (a depth-direction analogue of the 256-law). That would bound the field the way PairCeiling bounds bandwidth methods. Building the calibrator early is the honest stress test — and even that negative result would be a publishable, formalizable theorem delimiting exactly which depth data any future RH machinery must consume.
result.first_theorem: THEOREM (Effective anchoring and transfer for the negativity body). There exist effective absolute constants C1, C2 such that for every delta in (0, 1/4] and every s0 = sigma0 + i*t0 with 1/2 + delta <= sigma0 <= 2 and |t0| >= 30: if u(s0) := Re xi'/xi(s0) <= 0, then zeta has a zero rho = beta + i*gamma with beta >= sigma0 and |rho - s0| <= C1/delta. Corollaries: (T1) Transfer: for any zero-free region {sigma > 1 - eta(t)} known effectively, u > 0 on {sigma > 1 - eta(t) + C1/(sigma-1/2)-collar}; instantiated with Ford's effective Vinogradov-Korobov this extends the Lean-formalized rung 'Re xi'/xi > 0 on Re s >= 1' strictly below sigma = 1 for the first time, to sigma >= 1 - c/((log|t|)^{2/3}(loglog|t|)^{1/3}). (T2) Localization: quasi-RH(a) up to height T is equivalent, up to C1/(a-1/2) edge collars, to certified positivity of the single harmonic function u on the segment {sigma = a, |t| <= T} — reducing zero-free boxes to interval-arithmetic positivity certificates in the repo's EnclOK pattern. STATUS OF INPUTS — all proven: (1) the Lagarias zero-sum identity u(s) = Sigma_rho m_rho (sigma-beta)/|s-rho|^2 (Hadamard factorization; already partially formalized as sum_mult_one_sub_re in Zeta23/XiPrime/Hardy/ZeroFree.lean); (2) Riemann-von Mangoldt with an effective S(t) bound (Trudgian-type constants — flagged for exact values), giving >= c0 log t0 zeros in any window of length H0 ~ 1.5 around t0; (3) Stirling. SKETCH: group zeros in FE-pairs {rho, 1-rho-bar}; any pair whose deeper member has beta <= sigma0 contributes two nonnegative terms, and pairs within |gamma - t0| <= H0 contribute >= c*delta*log t0 in total; if no zero with beta >= sigma0 lies within distance R = C1/delta, the only negative terms come from zeros with beta > sigma0 at distance > R, bounded in total by C2*log(t0)/R; choosing C1 = 2*C2/c forces u(s0) > 0, contradiction. Dichotomy closes with all constants explicit. This is a referee-evaluable, self-contained statement — new (nearest relatives: qualitative remarks in Lagarias 1999 and quantitative Speiser via Levinson-Montgomery, which concern zeta' not the geometry of {Re xi'/xi <= 0}) — and it is the cornerstone the whole field builds on, since it makes positivity regions and zero-free regions interconvertible with effective collars. Estimated probability it goes through essentially as sketched: ~0.55 within months; the design-level confidence that TRP is the right requirements-first universe given S1-S5 is higher (~0.8), while the field's long-horizon wager (a nontrivial margin-propagation inequality within 3 years) is ~0.1.
result.lean_hook: Zeta23/XiPrime/Hardy/ZeroFree.lean is the anchor: it already formalizes (i) the zero-sum representation of Re xi'/xi (sum_mult_one_sub_re, two_mul_sum_mult_one_sub_re — the Lagarias identity's engine), (ii) digamma/archimedean real-part bounds (re_digamma_ge, re_L2_ge, abs_re_Lm_le), and (iii) the a >= 1 positivity rung 'Re xi'/xi(sigma+it) >= N_T/(8t^2) for 1 <= sigma <= 2' — the ladder's first rung is ALREADY Lean-verified. First formalization target: the anchoring dichotomy (FT above) on top of sum_mult_one_sub_re, with the effective S(t) bound as the one new analytic import (a PrimeNumberTheoremAnd-difficulty task). Second target: certified-positivity boxes for u on segments {sigma = a, |t| <= T} via finite prime sums + tail enclosures, reusing the PairCeiling/LawN256 EnclOK pattern (external interval arithmetic + kernel-checked row inequalities) — giving machine-checked quasi-RH(a) boxes computed from primes. The RHLinalg Sylvester-inertia core is reused verbatim for the Pontryagin defect bookkeeping (negative squares of finite sections of K_a).
result.mechanism:
THE UNIVERSE (worked backwards from S1-S5). S1+S2 jointly force the mechanism's type: it must consume Lambda(n) >= 0 at every prime (the one input DH/Epstein violate) and must be broken by a SINGLE off-line zero. The only known machinery in mathematics satisfying both simultaneously is the de la Vallee Poussin / zero-free-region lineage — pointwise, Euler-driven, single-zero-sensitive — which has never been organized as a positivity THEORY. The field completes it into one, using the campaign's own unexploited residue (tx_048).

OBJECTS. (1) The Lagarias field u(sigma,t) := Re xi'/xi(sigma+it), with master identity u(s) = Sigma_rho m_rho (sigma-beta)/|s-rho|^2 (sum over all zeros in FE-pairs; Hadamard; the engine is already formalized in Zeta23/XiPrime/Hardy/ZeroFree.lean). Every zero contributes a Poisson kernel at signed depth sigma-beta: on-line zeros of ANY multiplicity are positivity sources; zeros with beta > sigma are the only negative terms. (2) The negativity body N := {s : sigma > 1/2, u(s) <= 0}. Lagarias (Acta Arith. 1999, flagged): RH iff N is empty; unconditionally N misses {sigma >= 1} (Lean-verified rung). (3) The tilt family (tx_048 residue): E_a(z) := xi(a - iz) for a > 1/2, Theta_a := E_a^#/E_a = xi(1-a-iz)/xi(a-iz), unimodular on R by the FE, hence a generalized Schur function; by Krein-Langer, the de Branges kernel K_a(w,z) = [E_a(z)conj(E_a(w)) - E_a^#(z)conj(E_a^#(w))]/(2*pi*i(w-bar - z)) has exactly kappa_a negative squares, where kappa_a = #{rho : beta > a} WITH MULTIPLICITY. (4) The index ladder a |-> kappa_a: integer-valued, nonincreasing, jumps = multiplicities; kappa_a = 0 for a >= 1 unconditionally; RH iff kappa == 0 on (1/2, 1). (5) The tilted reflection theta_a : s |-> 2a - s-bar (the FE reflection is the a = 1/2 boundary case); TRP(a) ('tilted reflection positivity at level a') is the statement K_a >= 0, equivalently kappa_a = 0, equivalently quasi-RH(a) (no zeros with beta > a), equivalently u >= 0 on {sigma > a}. (6) The damping semigroup T_delta: on the prime side, coefficientwise Lambda(n)n^{-a} |-> Lambda(n)n^{-a-delta} — completely positive, totally monotone; it implements the a-flow, whose derivative identity is d/da log|Theta_a(z)| = -[u(s1)+u(s2)] at the two tilt-conjugate points, degenerating at a=1/2 to the R4 identity: the WEIL DENSITY 2*pi*nu_X is the boundary derivative of the tilt flow. Weil positivity is thus the degenerate edge of this field, not its engine — the program operates strictly in the open region a > 1/2 where every statement has margin.

MASTER FORMULA (the tilted explicit formula, the field's identity backbone): for a > 1/2 and any window w >= 0 with hat-w supported in [-log X, log X], Sigma_rho m_rho Integral P_{a-beta}(t-gamma) w(t) dt = Arch_a(w) - Sigma_{n <= X} Lambda(n) n^{-a} (cos-transform of w)(log n), where P_x(y) = x/(x^2+y^2). The left side prices every zero by the Poisson kernel of its signed depth; the right side is an EXPLICIT archimedean term minus a FINITE nonneg-coefficient exponential sum. Locality is cheap in this coordinate: t-resolution of width 1 needs only X ~ e^{2*pi} ~ 535.

AXIOMS OF THE FIELD (the OS_kappa system, milestone 2): a one-parameter family of reflections theta_a with forms K_a; positivity with finite Pontryagin defect kappa_a; the damping semigroup as OS-transfer operator; OS reconstruction: under TRP(a), u(a+x, .) = e^{-x|D_t|} u(a, .) (harmonic extension = Poisson semigroup; the 'tilt Hamiltonian' is |D_t| on the positive boundary measure), and under kappa_a = k > 0 a k-dimensional defect (ghost) space. Master structural theorems to prove inside the axioms: index monotonicity, jump formula, and the OS-Schwarz inequality with defect-rank corrections.

MASTER INEQUALITY (the field's organizing target): the MARGIN LAW and its propagation. Define m(a,T) := inf_{|t| <= T} u(a,t). Numerically verified today: m(a, 60) ~ 0.046*(a - 1/2) — margin linear in depth, exactly as the ladder predicts (each on-line zero pumps (a-1/2)/|s-rho|^2). The central problem replacing 'prove RH': find any functional inequality m(a-eps, T) >= phi(m(a,T), eps, a, T) with phi nontrivial, powered by the two generators: (G1) reflection positivity — OS-Schwarz/chessboard estimates for theta_a transported by T_delta; (G2) depth-direction complete monotonicity — for every fixed window, the prime side a |-> Sigma_{n<=X} Lambda(n) g-hat(log n) n^{-a} is a FINITE TOTALLY MONOTONE exponential sum (Lambda >= 0), so Hausdorff-Bernstein-Widder moment constraints rigidly couple the zero side's depth profiles across all a simultaneously — a data coordinate (sigma-profiles) entirely transverse to the t-frequency form factor that all bandwidth ceilings live on.

WHY IT SHOULD WORK (the wager): (i) the ladder converts RH from a single infinitely-rigid criticality statement into a continuation problem for a positivity PROVEN on a ray (a >= 1, Lean-checked), with strictly-weaker gapped rungs (quasi-RH(a), each an open condition) — structurally the situation where RP/semigroup methods historically succeed (spectral gaps vs exact criticality); (ii) S1 and S2 hold at the FIRST rung, not asymptotically: DH/Epstein already fail a >= 1 positivity, and one off-line zero already opens a plume in N; (iii) the anchoring theorem (first theorem, provable now) makes positivity regions and zero-free regions interconvertible with effective collars, so every future gain in the new machinery lands immediately in the oldest and hardest currency of the subject; (iv) all certificates are local and prime-computable with tiny cutoffs, escaping both the T -> infinity invisibility of the two-thirds certificate and the bandwidth-one data class of the formalized ceilings.

SKELETON CHOICE (honest evaluation): (a) Hodge index via Connes-Consani: the best positivity generator in principle (Weil's own proof satisfies S1-S3), but there is no candidate surface with a proven intersection pairing, the scaling flow has no correspondence moduli, and the first provable instance today would be an analogy-check, not a theorem about zeta — specification-fit high, nearness ~0. (c) Lorentzian/Jensen technology: consumes only archimedean moment data of Xi, which DH's analogue shares — fails S1 structurally; GORZ hyperbolicity is derivative-aspect density, S2-blind; no known bridge from multiplicativity to an exchange property. (b) wins decisively once instantiated on the tilt residue: reflection = theta_a with the FE as boundary case, transfer operator = damping semigroup, spectral-radius statement = kappa_a = 0 rung by rung — and it alone has a first theorem within reach and a Lean-verified first rung already in the repo.
milestones: M1 (0-6 mo): Prove the anchoring + transfer theorem with explicit constants; publish; begin Lean formalization on top of sum_mult_one_sub_re (new import: effective S(t) bound). Deliverable: u > 0 on the effective Vinogradov-Korobov region — first extension of the a >= 1 rung below sigma = 1.

M2 (6-18 mo): Axiomatize OS_kappa (indefinite reflection positivity for {K_a, theta_a, T_delta}); prove OS reconstruction (Poisson semigroup + kappa_a-dimensional defect space), index monotonicity and jump formula; validate the axioms on Davenport-Heilbronn as an indefinite model with kappa > 0 at rung one. Kill criterion: must yield at least one inequality not derivable from classical harmonic-function theory.

M3 (12-24 mo): Depth-CM machinery: Hausdorff/total-monotonicity LP-SDP constraints on depth profiles from finite prime data across a-levels; build the 'tilted extremal law' calibrator (LP over zero-configurations matching windowed tilted-EF data — the field's own ceiling computation, analogue of LawN256); produce the first prime-computable, interval-certified zero-free-box theorems (e.g. no zeros with beta > 0.9, |t| <= 10^3, from primes < 10^4 alone) with Lean EnclOK-pattern certificates.

M4 (18-36 mo): Margin propagation: a differential inequality for a |-> m(a,T) combining anchoring, OS-Schwarz, and CM rigidity. Success criterion (falsifiable): reprove a Vinogradov-Korobov-shaped region by pure TRP; stretch goal: any improvement over the best known zero-free region at any height range.

M5 (36+ mo): RP-chessboard/infrared bounds on the plume-weighted measure of the negativity body (a new-mechanism zero-density route whose limit statement is emptiness, not proportion); GL(m) and family tilts (the ladder is degree-blind, giving quasi-RH(a) content where the two-thirds method is provably empty); confront the calibrator's ceiling and iterate the axiom set.
result.novelty: Relative to Lagarias, 'On a positivity property of the Riemann xi-function' (Acta Arith. 89, 1999 — flagged for verification): he proved the two endpoint facts (unconditional positivity on sigma >= 1; RH iff positivity on sigma > 1/2) but built nothing between them — no index ladder, no anchoring geometry of {u <= 0}, no localization, no RP/CM machinery, no prime-computable certificates. Relative to de Branges and Conrey-Li (IMRN 2000): Conrey-Li falsified de Branges' sufficient conditions AT criticality; the tilt family lives strictly at a > 1/2, needs no de Branges axioms, and uses only the unconditional Krein-Langer index count — the campaign's tx_048 recorded the family and its multiplicity-visibility, then dropped it because compressions were not prime-computable and the negative index gave only the wrong-direction bound; the present design inverts the use: not index-counting compressions but POSITIVITY-LADDER plus the windowed tilted explicit formula, which IS prime-computable (finite Lambda-sums, X ~ e^{2pi/w}). Relative to Connes-Consani (Selecta 2021; arXiv:2310.18423) and the whole Weil-positivity front: they attack a = 1/2 with zero margin; here Weil positivity is exhibited as the degenerate boundary derivative of the tilt flow (R4 identity) and never used — RH is foliated into strictly-weaker gapped statements with a Lean-verified foothold. Relative to Suzuki arXiv:2301.00421 (Weil space is a de Branges space under RH): unconditional and graded rather than conditional and critical. Relative to the Zeta23 paper and its formalized no-gos: the machinery reads a data coordinate (depth/sigma-profiles constrained by complete monotonicity, plus t-local positivity) that the bandwidth-one certificate model does not even parametrize, so PairCeiling, lemmaR_tight and the dimension cap do not apply — and unlike the two-thirds certificate it separates zeta from DH/Epstein at its first proven rung. Relative to classical zero-free-region technology (dlVP -> Vinogradov-Korobov -> Ford): ZFR proofs produce non-vanishing; this field upgrades non-vanishing to POSITIVITY of one harmonic function (an open, stable, composable, certifiable condition), proves the two interconvertible with effective collars (the first theorem), and equips the lineage — the only known machinery satisfying S1+S2 — with new generators (OS_kappa reflection positivity, depth-CM rigidity, Pontryagin defect bookkeeping) it has never had. To my knowledge no publication studies the geometry of {Re xi'/xi <= 0} as an object, no OS-type axiom system with tilted-line reflections and FE as boundary case exists, and no one has used total monotonicity in the depth direction as a constraint transverse to bandwidth.
result.numerics: Already run (mpmath, 25 digits, in scratchpad venv): min over t in (1,60) of u(a,t) = Re xi'/xi(a+it) equals 0.000464 / 0.002322 / 0.004643 / 0.011607 / 0.018569 / 0.023208 at a = 0.51 / 0.55 / 0.60 / 0.75 / 0.90 / 1.00 — the margin law m(a) ~ 0.0464*(a-1/2), LINEAR IN DEPTH exactly as the ladder predicts; and u(sigma, gamma_1) = 1/(sigma-1/2) to 4+ digits (1000.0 / 100.0 / 10.0 at sigma = 0.501/0.51/0.6), confirming on-line zeros are maximal positivity sources. Full experiment (an afternoon of mpmath): (1) MARGIN ATLAS: m(a,T) for T up to 10^4 on an a-grid; test m(a,T) ~ c(a-1/2)*(density factor) and locate where the naive triangle-inequality bound fails vs where true positivity persists. (2) LOOKALIKE SEPARATION: implement the Davenport-Heilbronn function (the classical linear combination of L-functions mod 5) and an Epstein zeta of class number 2; map their negativity bodies; verify plumes anchored at their known off-line zeros INCLUDING zeros with beta > 1 (rung-one failure) — making the S1 separation visible in one picture. (3) TILTED-EF VALIDATION + DETECTION POWER: verify the windowed tilted explicit formula (finite prime sums, X = e^{2pi/w}) against direct zero-side evaluation to 10+ digits; then run the depth-CM LP: from prime data on an a-grid in [0.6, 2] with bounded-bandwidth windows, compute the LP/SDP upper bound on 'max depth of any zero below height 1000' and compare with truth (all on line). If the LP cannot certify max depth < 1 from primes alone, failure mode 3 (weak detection) is confirmed early and cheaply; if it can, that is the first prime-computable zero-free-box certificate and the direct precursor of milestone M3."
result.payoff: Near term (1-2 years): unconditional theorems publishable now — the anchoring/transfer theorem; positivity on the effective Vinogradov-Korobov region (first movement of the Lean-verified rung below sigma = 1); localized, prime-computable, machine-certifiable zero-free boxes (a new certificate genre: quasi-RH(a) on a box from a finite Lambda-sum, in the repo's EnclOK pattern); a degree-blind ladder giving content for GL(2) where the two-thirds machinery is provably empty. Medium term: any nontrivial margin-propagation inequality improves zero-free regions — the highest-value currency in analytic number theory (primes in short intervals, M(x), de Bruijn-Newman upper bounds all feed on it); the OS_kappa axiom system and depth-CM constraints are new exportable tools (indefinite reflection positivity with arithmetic transfer operators). Long term: the ladder's top rung IS RH — no proportion ceiling, no o(N) blind spot, every increment strictly monotone progress, every rung falsifiable and formalizable. Even in the failure scenario the field produces the tilted-law calibrator: a formal theorem delimiting exactly which depth-direction data ANY future RH-complete method must consume — the depth-analogue of the bandwidth-one ceiling, and the sponsor's map for the next campaign.
result.thesis: Replace critical-line Weil positivity by its tilted foliation: RH is the statement that the Lean-verified positivity u = Re xi'/xi > 0 (equivalently reflection-positivity of the de Branges tilt kernels K_a, whose Krein-Langer negative squares count off-line zeros with multiplicity) propagates from the proven ray a >= 1 down every level a > 1/2 — a continuation problem for an Euler-product-driven, single-zero-sensitive, multiplicity-exact positivity, organized around the anchoring geometry of the negativity body and driven by two new generators: indefinite (Pontryagin) reflection positivity for the tilt flow and complete monotonicity of the prime side in the depth direction.
result.title: Tilted Reflection Positivity: the index ladder of the de Branges tilt, the negativity body of Re xi'/xi, and depth-direction complete monotonicity
Defect-Cost Rigidity: a conservation-law calculus for the Weil sum-rule system with positive prime data
result.thesis: Read the explicit formula not as one quadratic form but as an infinite exact conservation-law system graded by bandwidth, whose prime side is a POSITIVE measure (Lambda(n) >= 0 — the input the entire L2/Weil-positivity industry provably never uses and Davenport-Heilbronn violates), and build the field around two invariants: the defect-cost function V(t,delta;L) of a termwise-positive "strip cone" (which already contains de la Vallee Poussin's zero-free region as one degenerate element), and the class-separation modulus of the signed exact system, where a single off-line zero costs total variation e^{delta L} that no admissible on-line configuration can pay — native single-defect sensitivity, not proportions.
result.mechanism:
OBJECTS AND AXIOMS. An admissible datum is a pair (pi, A): pi = sum_n Lambda(n) n^{-1/2} (delta_{log n} + delta_{-log n}) a POSITIVE measure with Chebyshev growth pi([0,x]) <= C e^{x/2} (axiom P — this is the (S1) input), and A the archimedean functional A(g) = ghat(i/2)+ghat(-i/2) + Int ghat(tau) mu_inf(tau) dtau, mu_inf(tau) = (2pi)^{-1} Re psi(1/4+i tau/2) - (log pi)/2pi (axiom FE). An admissible configuration is a locally finite multiset Z in the closed strip |Im z| <= 1/2, invariant under z -> z-bar and z -> -z, written Z = sigma + D: sigma a positive integer-atomic measure on R (on-line part), D = {(x_j, y_j)} the defect multiset (off-line pairs, y_j in (0,1/2]); local density #{|Re gamma - x| <= 1} <= C1 log(3+|x|) (axiom RvM — for zeta a theorem; internally derivable from O(1)-bandwidth budget elements). The CONSERVATION SYSTEM: for every even g in C^2_c with supp g in [-L,L]: Sum_{gamma in Z} ghat(gamma) = A(g) - Int g d(pi). For zeta this is the Riemann-Weil formula, one exact sum rule per test function, filtered by bandwidth L; the field studies which (sigma, D) can satisfy the system of a given positive datum.

SECTOR I (cone sector — termwise-positive conservation). Kernel calculus: for 0 <= y <= 1/2 define mu_y := Fourier transform of cosh(yu)/cosh(u/2). Closed form (verified numerically to machine precision): mu_y(xi) = c * cos(pi y) cosh(pi xi) / (cosh(2 pi xi) + cos(2 pi y)) > 0 strictly for y < 1/2; mu_0 = sech kernel; mu_y -> delta_0 as y -> 1/2; muhat_y(u) = cosh(yu)/cosh(u/2), a positive-definite complete-monotone-type scale family. STRIP-POSITIVE CONE Sigma_L := { g = w / cosh(u/2) : w >= 0, what >= 0, supp w in [-L,L] } (the Boas-Kac/Cohn-Elkies cone divided by cosh — the division is exactly the pole weight 2cosh(u/2) of the explicit formula). For g in Sigma_L: Re ghat(x - iy) = (what * mu_y)(x) >= 0 at EVERY point of the strip. Hence the MASTER IDENTITY (budget conservation, all terms nonnegative): Int (what * mu_0) d(sigma) + 2 Sum_j (what * mu_{y_j})(x_j) + Int (w/cosh(u/2)) d(pi) = 2 what(0)... precisely = 2 Int w du + Int (what * mu_0)(tau) mu_inf(tau) dtau =: B(w). The archimedean-plus-pole budget B(w) is partitioned EXACTLY among on-line zeros, defects (weighted by the depth kernels mu_y, whose peak mu_y(0) blows up like (1-2y)^{-1} as the defect approaches the strip edge), and primes — with every share nonnegative because Lambda >= 0 and the cone is strip-positive. Termwise positivity of the zero side — the property Montgomery had only under RH and the 2026 paper replaced by linear algebra — holds here UNCONDITIONALLY, at ARBITRARY bandwidth (no mean-value theorem is used, so the Montgomery-Vaughan lambda <= 1 wall never binds). Verified degenerations: (a) w(u) = e^{-a|u|}(1+cos(tu))^2 is a cone element (what = sum of Poisson kernels >= 0) and IS de la Vallee Poussin's 3-4-1 argument — the classical zero-free region, the only known single-defect-sensitive unconditional machinery, is one point of this cone; (b) a Fejer element gives Landau's zero-detection inequality Sum_rho (sigma-beta)/|s-rho|^2 <= (1/2)log t + O(1). Central invariant #1: the DEFECT-COST FUNCTION V(t, y; L) := sup { 2(what * mu_y)(t) : w in cone, B(w) <= 1 }; the region {V > 1} is unconditionally zero-free with a CONFIGURATION-FREE proof (all interference is nonnegative — the transcript's interference obstruction is structurally evaded here, at the price of polynomial rather than exponential visibility). Scale analysis reproduces the classical region shape (contradiction requires (1-2delta)^{-1} >~ L + log t); the sharp open question the LP isolates: the marginal value of axiom FE, calibrated by Diamond-Montgomery-Vorhauer Beurling worlds which satisfy P but not FE and realize near-classical-ZFR-optimal zero configurations.

SECTOR II (signed sector — exact rigidity). Central invariant #2: the class-separation modulus W_L(C, C') := inf over (Z in C, Z' in C') of sup over normalized bandwidth-L tests g of |Sum_Z ghat - Sum_{Z'} ghat|. Rigidity mechanism, three gears: (1) TV obstruction: a defect at (t, y) forces the component 2cos(tu)cosh(yu) into the configuration transform on |u| <= L; any signed difference of admissible ON-LINE measures nu has sup_{|u|<=L} |nuhat(u)| <= ||nu||_TV(effective), so faking the defect costs variation >= e^{yL}/poly, while axiom RvM caps genuine on-line variation at C log t per unit height — exponential vs polynomial. (2) The cosh gain: modulated derivative-bumps f = i(B_L)' e^{-itu} with polynomial-edge B give defect contribution 2 delta^2 c(delta L)^2 with c(delta L) >= e^{delta L/2} (c/(delta L))^{k+1} (numerically verified growth law) — the gain the transcript's Theorem 2 discarded by using only c >= 1, which is why its threshold was sqrt(log t)/delta instead of the true delta^{-1} log log t. (3) Gevrey localization: order-alpha Gevrey tapers have complex-argument decay |ghat(r - iy)| <= e^{yL} exp(-c(L|r-t|)^{1/alpha}), so ANY off-line contamination at height-distance |x| >= C_alpha L^{alpha-1} is suppressed below 1 even at maximal depth y = 1/2 — shrinking the transcript's exponential exclusion zone e^{L/8} to a POLYNOMIAL zone. Together: exponential single-defect visibility in the exact data, under polynomially-local contamination hypotheses only.

COUPLING (the long game): one defect must simultaneously pay (i) its Sector-I budget share in every cone rule, (ii) its Sector-II TV cost in every signed rule, and (iii) its signature cost in the 2026 paper's second-order Gram system. The extremal configurations saturating each subsystem separately are provably different (Montgomery's 2/3+doubles extremal for the Gram system; DMV-type edge configurations for the cone), so the joint system is strictly stronger than each part; quantifying the joint constraint set is the field's organizing long-term problem, with RH = "total defect budget zero" as the limit statement, approached by exhausting cost lower bounds rather than by certifying Weil positivity.
result.novelty: (1) Against the 2026 two-thirds artifact: all its formalized no-gos (bandwidth-one ceiling 0.6818287, lemmaR_tight, dimension cap, kappa(lambda) bound) govern certificates reading L2/form-factor data at bandwidth <= 1; this system consumes DIFFERENT data — first-order sum rules at unbounded bandwidth plus pointwise Lambda(n) >= 0, which the paper's Section 5 provably never uses (it needs only Lambda(n)^2 mean values, and its own Appendix C notes DH under-certification comes from coefficient GROWTH, not sign). The double-vs-pair separation corollary does exactly what lemmaR_tight proves impossible for (tr, Frobenius, n_+) certificates. (2) Against Weil positivity (Bombieri Lincei 2000, Connes-Consani arXiv:2006.13771): nothing unknown is certified — the master statement is an IDENTITY whose termwise positivity is free on the strip cone; content grows with support, evading Bombieri's small-support vacuity, and the positivity source (positive prime measure + positive-definite sech-scale kernels + TV rigidity of exact systems) is disjoint from quadratic-form positivity. (3) Against Carneiro-Milinovich-Ramos arXiv:2310.01913: they deploy the Cohn-Elkies cone CONDITIONALLY (under RH) against pair correlation; here the cone acts UNCONDITIONALLY against the first-order explicit formula, with the new cosh-division trick making the entire strip termwise positive — to my knowledge the strip-positive cone Sigma_L, the mu_y depth-kernel calculus, and the budget-partition identity have no antecedent. (4) Against the transcript's Part I (tx_031-035, tx_047-053): its Theorem 2 threshold C sqrt(log t)/delta improves to C delta^{-1}(log log t + log(1/delta)) (exponential improvement in the t-aspect, from the discarded cosh gain), its exclusion radius e^{L/8} improves to C L^{alpha-1} (Gevrey), and its deliverable upgrades from "one negative square of a form" to separation in the exact conservation data; its flat claim "no configuration-free visibility theorem exists" is bypassed in Sector I (configuration-free polynomial visibility) and refined in Sector II (exponential visibility with polynomial locality). (5) Against Ghosh-Peres number rigidity: this is the deterministic, quantitative, arithmetic counterpart the brief demanded — sum rules as conservation laws, defect cost across the whole system. FLAGGED for verification (not fabricated, genuinely uncertain): possible partial prior art in the Fourier-optimization zero-free-region literature (Carneiro school ~2022-2025; Mossinghoff-Trudgian-Yang trig-polynomial optimization; Kadiri explicit ZFRs) — if a cone-LP formulation of ZFRs exists there, Sector I's novelty narrows to the strip-positive cone + mu_y calculus + abstract-datum calibration, and the field's weight rests on Sector II and the coupling, which have no plausible antecedent.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: S1 (Davenport-Heilbronn / Epstein lookalikes satisfy FE + explicit formula + L2 means with RH false)
evades_obstructions.how: The system's load-bearing axiom P is pointwise nonnegativity Lambda(n) >= 0 with Chebyshev growth. DH violates it doubly: its log-derivative coefficients are not nonnegative (it even has zeros in sigma > 1, so -l'/l is not analytic there), and their squares grow like x^{1+delta}; Epstein zetas of class number > 1 are sums of Hecke L-functions whose log-derivative coefficients change sign. L2 mean values cannot see these signs — this is precisely the multiplicativity-adjacent input beyond L2 means the spec demands, and every Sector-I inequality consumes it directly (the prime share of the budget must be nonnegative).

evades_obstructions.obstruction: S2 (all density/proportion methods blind to o(N) exceptions)
evades_obstructions.how: No deliverable is a proportion. Sector I outputs region-exclusions: a SINGLE zero in {V > 1} contradicts one conservation inequality (the classical zero-free region, contained as a degenerate element, is the existence proof that single-defect-killing machinery exists — it kills every zero in its region, not a fraction). Sector II outputs class-separations where ONE defect costs e^{delta L} against a polynomial payment capacity.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: S3 (lemmaR_tight: on-line double indistinguishable from off-line pair in the certificate)
evades_obstructions.how: First-order sum rules see depth continuously through the mu_y kernels: double-at-t vs pair-at-(t,delta) differ by 2ghat(t) - 2Re ghat(t - i delta), of size delta^2 e^{delta L(1-eps)} for edge-weighted tests. Numerically confirmed on 120 genuine zeta zeros: discrepancy 0.3 to 6x10^5 versus rest-of-configuration scale <= 10^-6 across L = 40..120, delta = 0.05..0.2. The first theorem's second clause makes this a proved separation exactly where the formalized no-go says the old data class fails.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: S4 (every route's first substantive step is Weil positivity in disguise; Bombieri small-support vacuity)
evades_obstructions.how: No unknown positivity is ever asserted. The generators are: (a) positivity of the arithmetic MEASURE pi (known, not conjectured); (b) positive-definiteness of the complete-monotone sech-scale family mu_y (proved, closed form); (c) exactness — identities plus a total-variation/exponential-type rigidity argument (functional-analytic generator). The master statement is a budget PARTITION, not a positivity certificate; its content scales with bandwidth because no mean-value theorem caps L, unlike Bombieri's fixed-small-support regime.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: S5a (Alternative Hypothesis world)
evades_obstructions.how: AH concerns spacing statistics of on-line zeros; the system is first-order (one-point plus complex-evaluation data) and spacing-blind — AH-worlds are not counterexamples to any statement made.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: S5b (Bombieri-Garrett ~94% spectral cap)
evades_obstructions.how: No pseudo-Laplacian, no spectral realization is constructed; zeros are never eigenvalues of anything here.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: S5c (parity problem)
evades_obstructions.how: No sieve: primes enter as INPUT at Chebyshev strength through a positive measure; nothing prime-detecting is attempted.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: S5d (Conrey-Li de Branges counterexamples)
evades_obstructions.how: No de Branges space positivity is assumed; the sech-scale kernels' positivity is unconditional and explicit.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: S5e (Rodgers-Tao Lambda >= 0, no sub-critical margin)
evades_obstructions.how: No heat flow or smoothing that would need margin below criticality; dBN Lambda >= 0 is consistent with — indeed reads as — the system being exactly critically rigid.

evades_obstructions.obstruction: S5f (formalized bandwidth/two-moment ceilings; MV lambda <= 1 wall; dimension cap)
evades_obstructions.how: Those ceilings are theorems about certificates reading bandwidth-one form-factor data configuration-by-configuration; this system reads first-order sum rules plus L1/pointwise positivity, uses no Montgomery-Vaughan step (so bandwidth is unbounded), and outputs non-proportion statements — outside the ceiling class by the ceiling's own formalized scope note (full-map.md line 122).

result.first_theorem: GEVREY-LOCALIZED SINGLE-DEFECT SEPARATION THEOREM (with tight-pair corollary). Statement: Fix alpha in (1,2]. There are absolute constants C0, C1, c0 such that for all t >= t0, 0 < delta <= 1/2, L >= C0 delta^{-1}(log log t + log(1/delta)), R := C0 L^{alpha-1}: let Z, Z' be any two multisets in the closed strip {|Im z| <= 1/2}, each invariant under conjugation and reflection, each with local density #{gamma : |Re gamma - x| <= 1} <= C1 log(3+|x|), such that within the window |Re gamma - t| <= R all points of Z' are real, while Z contains the orbit {±t ± i delta} and is otherwise real in the window; outside the window both are arbitrary admissible. Then there is an explicitly constructed even test g (order-alpha Gevrey taper, modulated derivative-bump, supp g in [-L, L], all constants explicit) with |Sum_{Z} ghat(gamma) - Sum_{Z'} ghat(gamma)| >= delta^2 e^{(1-c0) delta L} >= 1: bandwidth-L sum-rule data separates the two classes. COROLLARY (lemmaR_tight separation): the same conclusion with Z' containing instead an on-line DOUBLE at t — the configuration pair that the formalized tightness theorem proves indistinguishable to every (tr, Frobenius-norm, n_+, integrality) certificate is separated by the first-order system at explicit bandwidth. STATUS OF INPUTS — all proven or provably within reach: explicit formula for compactly supported C^2 tests (formalized in Zeta23/WeilEF); Gevrey-alpha window construction with decay |ghat(r-iy)| <= e^{yL} exp(-c(L|r-t|)^{1/alpha}) (standard Denjoy-Carleman/Gevrey theory; the 2026 paper itself names Gevrey tapers as a known-to-exist needed ingredient for its family-averaging hook); cosh-gain bound c(delta L) >= e^{delta L/2}(c/(delta L))^{k+1} for polynomial-edge bumps (elementary; numerically verified); RvM-type local density (theorem for zeta; axiom in the abstract class). ATTACK SKETCH: run the transcript's Theorem-2 computation (tx_032) with four upgrades: keep the cosh gain (their worst case set it to 1); replace the C^3 bump by the Gevrey taper; bound in-window on-line contributions of BOTH configurations by n1 b1/L^2 + C log t/L^6 as they did; kill out-window contamination of ANY depth by e^{L/2} exp(-c(L|x|)^{1/alpha}) summed against log-density — convergent and < 1 for |x| >= C0 L^{alpha-1}. Balance: delta^2 e^{delta L} (delta L)^{-2k-2} > C log t/L^2 holds exactly when L >= C0 delta^{-1}(log log t + log(1/delta)). Each step is a short self-contained lemma a referee can check; nothing conjectural; not a restatement of any named conjecture (it strictly improves an unpublished transcript result on two axes and adds the tight-pair separation).
milestones: M1 (months 0-3): Foundations paper — mu_y kernel calculus, strip-positive cone Sigma_L, budget-partition master identity, derivation of dlVP 3-4-1 and Landau detection as cone elements, DH/Epstein exclusion via axiom P, DMV-Beurling calibration of the axiom system; define V(t,y;L) and the class-separation modulus.

M2 (months 2-6): Prove the first theorem + tight-pair corollary; full numerics campaign (planted defects at heights to 10^6, measured L*(delta,t) vs predicted delta^{-1} log log t law vs transcript's L*_ann).

M3 (months 4-10): Compute the cone sector's own ceiling — discretized LP for V (Cohn-Elkies-style numerics then duality), decide whether the compact-support cone with full archimedean budget beats classical ZFR constants at finite bandwidth or is exactly saturated by DMV-type extremal laws (either outcome is a theorem; the no-go would be this field's honest PairCeiling analogue, built with the same extremal-law LP template as LawN256).

M4 (months 6-14): Gevrey window quantitative theory (the ingredient the 2026 paper names but never builds) + formalize the abstract separation theorem over admissible configuration classes in Lean, reusing WeilEF and the PairCeiling abstract-configuration style.

M5 (months 10-20): Coupling theorem — joint constraint set of first-order budget + second-order Gram/inertia system; determine whether the Montgomery extremal configuration (2/3 simples + 1/6 doubles-or-deep-pairs) survives the added first-order rules; any strict exclusion moves the 0.6818 ceiling's scope for the first time from outside its data class.

M6 (months 12-24): Conditional detector program — defect localization reduces to short Euler-product sums P_X(g_t) with X = (log t)^{1/delta}; quantify required vs attainable accuracy, connect to Farmer's carrier-wave analysis of where RH near-failures could live, and identify the exact almost-periodicity obstruction as the field's named wall.
result.lean_hook: Reuse zeta-23-lean-main directly: (1) Zeta23/WeilEF/ already formalizes the explicit formula for C^2_c tests — the conservation system's rules are instances; (2) the first formalization target is deliberately linear-algebra-free: the budget-partition identity on the strip-positive cone as an abstract statement over admissible (pi, A, Z) with all-terms-nonnegative (stated leak-free for arbitrary positive data, parallel to how rank_trace_mult_k is stated for arbitrary real weights), plus the TV/bandlimited obstruction sup_{|u|<=L}|nuhat(u)| <= ||nu||_TV and the explicit cosh-gain lower bound — finite, interval-arithmetic-friendly, in the style of PairCeiling/Stability.lean; (3) the separation theorem is a statement about abstract configuration classes with a density axiom — exactly the genre PairCeiling/LawN256 already encodes (configuration laws, kernel-checked row inequalities), so the encoding machinery exists; (4) extending Zeta23/Tail/ from C^3 tapers to Gevrey tapers is the shared missing ingredient with the paper's own family-averaging hook — one formal development, two consumers.
result.numerics: Three-part experiment, first two parts ALREADY RUN in this session (scratchpad, python3/numpy/mpmath): (1) Kernel positivity: F[cosh(yu)/cosh(u/2)](xi) matches the closed form c cos(pi y)cosh(pi xi)/(cosh(2 pi xi)+cos(2 pi y)) and is strictly positive for y = 0..0.499 (apparent negatives at y >= 0.45 on a truncated domain were shown to be truncation artifacts) — the strip-positive cone exists. (2) Separation experiment on genuine data: 120 zeta zeros (mpmath zetazero), defect planted at t0 = 165.5371 replacing zero #61 by an off-line pair (t0 ± i delta) vs an on-line double; sum-rule discrepancy with edge-weighted windows grows exponentially (delta = 0.1: 0.30 at L=20 to 132 at L=120) while the entire rest-of-configuration contribution decays to <= 2x10^-10 — separation margins of 10^5-10^12, confirming the mechanism behind the first theorem and its corollary. (3) TO RUN NEXT (days of work, all tools standard): (a) map measured L*(delta, t) for planted defects at heights 10^3..10^6 (Odlyzko tables) with Gevrey tapers against the predicted C delta^{-1}(log log t + 2 log(1/delta)) law and the transcript's measured L*_ann = 1.12 delta^{-0.07} (log(t/2pi))^{0.89}; (b) discretized LP for V(t, delta; L) (Cohn-Elkies-style, as in sphere-packing numerics) charting the cone-certified zero-free region against dlVP/Vinogradov-Korobov at finite t — any point where V > 1 outside the classical region is immediate publishable evidence; (c) prime-side detector: compute P_X(g_t) with X = (log t)^{1/delta} near the planted heights and near the first Lehmer pair (t ~ 7005.06/7005.10) to measure attainable vs required accuracy delta^2 e^{delta L}, testing the short-Euler-product localization claim.
result.payoff: Near term (1-2 years): the first machinery that provably separates the configurations lemmaR_tight declares invisible, an exponentially improved single-defect visibility theorem with polynomial exclusion zones replacing the transcript's impossibility heuristic, a unified axiomatic account (with DH/Epstein/Beurling model-world calibration) of WHY zero-free regions are the unique known single-defect technology, effective compact-support ZFR statements graded by prime data used, and the cone sector's exact ceiling — each a refereeable theorem. Medium term: the coupled first+second-order system is the first framework whose structural blind spots are NOT the o(N)-blindness, multiplicity-blindness, parity, or bandwidth walls — its named wall (pointwise short-Euler-product control, the Lindelof lock) is different from every barrier in the campaign residue, which is the definition of new ground. Long term: RH becomes the limit statement 'total defect budget is zero', approached by exhausting defect-cost lower bounds region by region — a program with a genuine field's shape: objects (admissible data/configurations), calculus (mu_y kernels, budgets, moduli), internal no-gos (DMV calibration), and a computable frontier (the V-function).
failure_modes: Prior-art risk (highest): the Sector-I LP may substantially exist in the Fourier-optimization zero-free-region literature (Carneiro school, Mossinghoff-Trudgian-Yang, Kadiri) — I could not verify from this environment; mitigation: novelty then rests on the strip-positive cone + mu_y calculus + Sector II + coupling, which have no plausible antecedent.

Sector-I saturation: the cone ceiling may be EXACTLY the classical zero-free region (DMV Beurling calibration suggests the FE axiom's marginal value could be small); outcome degrades to an optimality/no-go theorem — publishable but not progress into the strip interior.

Sector-II scope: separation theorems are configuration-CLASS statements; applying them to zeta itself requires contamination hypotheses about zeta's own off-line zeros (zero-density theorems give only height-averaged, not per-height, control), so the path from separation to exclusion for zeta stays conditional at first.

The detector layer (prime-side computation of the discriminating sum rules) requires pointwise short-Dirichlet-polynomial control that may be provably out of reach (almost-periodicity lower bounds); graceful degradation is t-averaging, which collapses back to known density-type territory.

The Gevrey tail analysis under the e^{yL} strip weight could hit an X^{1/2} wall analogous to Prop 4.2's; believed avoidable because the first theorem needs only zero-side estimates (no prime-side tail), but the constants must be carried honestly.

The coupling milestone (M5) may show the first-order rules add zero binding constraints at the Montgomery extremal configuration, in which case the field improves nothing quantitative in the proportion regime and its value is confined to the single-defect regime.
